cases.spec_ref: `lat rules --json` emits the numbered-rules catalogue (`{schema_version, rules:[...]}`), documented byte-identical to the Rust binary on every launcher (README-cli.md). It is the verb that CRASHED on npx (laterite-dev#508 — the JS launcher iterated the object as an array; only `--json`, the path then tested, worked) and had NO cross-surface case until laterite-dev#555 part 2. A verb every launcher advertises but one cannot run is invisible to a name-only census diff; this pins the whole render + exit code equal across the three.
